# One UPS on mains power, fully charged. Written from the NUT network
# protocol docs and the usbhid-ups variable names; not recorded.
> VER
< Network UPS Tools upsd 2.8.2 - https://www.networkupstools.org/
> LIST UPS
< BEGIN LIST UPS
< UPS rack "Rack UPS"
< END LIST UPS
> LIST VAR rack
< BEGIN LIST VAR rack
< VAR rack battery.charge "100"
< VAR rack battery.charge.low "20"
< VAR rack battery.runtime "2730"
< VAR rack battery.runtime.low "180"
< VAR rack battery.type "PbAc"
< VAR rack device.mfr "EATON"
< VAR rack device.model "5P 1550"
< VAR rack device.serial "FAKE00000001"
< VAR rack device.type "ups"
< VAR rack driver.name "usbhid-ups"
< VAR rack driver.version "2.8.2"
< VAR rack input.voltage "231.4"
< VAR rack input.voltage.nominal "230"
< VAR rack output.voltage "230.0"
< VAR rack ups.beeper.status "enabled"
< VAR rack ups.firmware "02.08.0010"
< VAR rack ups.load "23"
< VAR rack ups.mfr "EATON"
< VAR rack ups.model "5P 1550"
< VAR rack ups.realpower "251"
< VAR rack ups.realpower.nominal "1100"
< VAR rack ups.status "OL"
< VAR rack ups.test.result "Done and passed"
< END LIST VAR rack
